purpose: Owner-authorised college project presentation dataset for GitHub ZIP downloads.
record_provenance: Includes submitted profiles and user-requested illustrative profiles and academic records. Generated marks, attendance and submissions are not official college results.
login_mode: Account passwords are redacted in the public bundle. First local startup creates new per-installation passwords and a private instance/PRAVA_Local_Login_Details.txt handout.

attendance_calendar.provenance: Owner-requested illustrative records; not official college attendance. See docs/attendance-and-timetable.md.

connected_workflows: Student attendance audit, class-teacher allocations and shared academic records are enabled. Existing staff attendance is retained; new dates are unmarked until Principal/Admin entry. Read views check for committed changes every 15 seconds on the same server/database.
private_data_excluded: Account password hashes, login handouts, import previews and sign-up requests are excluded. First startup generates local-only passwords.
